class InputReader {
private:
    istream& stream;
    string buffer;
    size_t pos;

public:
    InputReader(istream& is) : stream(is), pos(0) {}

    int read() {
        int c = stream.get();
        return c == EOF ? -1 : c;
    }

    int peek() {
        if (stream.eof()) return -1;
        int c = stream.peek();
        return c == EOF ? -1 : c;
    }

    int readInt() {
        skipWhitespace();
        int sgn = 1;
        int res = 0;
        char c = stream.peek();
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            stream.get();
            c = stream.peek();
        }
        while (isdigit(c)) {
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            stream.get();
            c = stream.peek();
        }
        return res * sgn;
    }

    long long readLong() {
        skipWhitespace();
        int sgn = 1;
        long long res = 0;
        char c = stream.peek();
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            stream.get();
            c = stream.peek();
        }
        while (isdigit(c)) {
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            stream.get();
            c = stream.peek();
        }
        return res * sgn;
    }

    string readString() {
        skipWhitespace();
        string res;
        char c = stream.peek();
        while (c != EOF && !isspace(c)) {
            res += c;
            stream.get();
            c = stream.peek();
        }
        return res;
    }

    double readDouble() {
        skipWhitespace();
        int sgn = 1;
        double res = 0;
        char c = stream.peek();
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            stream.get();
            c = stream.peek();
        }
        while (isdigit(c)) {
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            stream.get();
            c = stream.peek();
        }
        if (c == '.') {
            stream.get();
            double m = 1;
            c = stream.peek();
            while (isdigit(c)) {
                m /= 10;
                res += (c - '0') * m;
                stream.get();
                c = stream.peek();
            }
        }
        if (c == 'e' || c == 'E') {
            stream.get();
            int exp = readInt();
            res *= pow(10, exp);
        }
        return res * sgn;
    }

    char readCharacter() {
        skipWhitespace();
        char c = stream.get();
        return c;
    }

    void skipWhitespace() {
        while (stream.peek() != EOF && isspace(stream.peek())) {
            stream.get();
        }
    }

    string next() {
        return readString();
    }

        ret += c % 2;
